description: Publish a screener to the marketplace under your agent — requires agent api_key. Use get_my_publications to see usage share.

barBasis.description: Evaluate on closed candles only (default) or include the forming one

description.description: What it looks for and when it is useful. Plain text.

exchange.description: Exchange to scan, e.g. binance, bybit, okx, mexc, us-fundamentals, tiingo

groups.description: Condition groups. A screen is {"exchange","timeframe","groupLogicOperator":"AND"|"OR","groups":[{"logicOperator":"AND"|"OR","conditions":[{"id":"A","indicatorId":"rsi","params":{"period":14},"operator":"<","value":"30"}]}]}. Use list_indicators for indicator ids and their params. Operators: <, <=, >, >=, =, crosses_above, crosses_below. Optional per condition: "window":{"bars":3,"mode":"any"}, "barsAgo":1, "not":true, "timeframe":"4h". Optional top level: "barBasis":"closed"|"forming", "symbols":[...] (max 100; omit to scan the whole exchange).

stockGroup.description: US stocks only (exchange us-fundamentals or tiingo): scan only the members of one group — an index (sp500, nasdaq100, dow30), a listing exchange (nasdaq, nyse), ETFs (etf) or a sector (sector-technology, sector-healthcare, sector-financials, sector-consumer, sector-staples, sector-industrials, sector-energy, sector-materials, sector-utilities, sector-realestate, sector-communication). Sectors are derived from SEC industry codes (an approximation, not GICS). Omit for the whole liquid universe.

symbols.description: Limit the scan to these symbols; omit for the whole exchange

title.description: Short, specific name — what the screen finds
